_comment: Threshold requirements, North Dakota 2027. Section 5, PDF pp.9-12. Mandatory and carrying no points, but not costless: Section 5 assesses a 2-point deduction for each requirement missing after the closing date, recorded as a negative criterion in ND_2027.json.

criteria.heading: Application
criteria.quote: currently published Multifamily Application must be fully completed and executed
criteria.note: HOME or HTF applications additionally require a Sam.gov Unique Entity Identifier for every team member contracting with the final owner.

criteria.heading: Demonstrated site control
criteria.quote: An as-developed site plan must accompany the application
criteria.note: Control must be held and contractually maintainable across the whole application period and the project's full anticipated scope.

criteria.heading: Zoning, codes and ordinances
criteria.quote: Applicant shall provide evidence of current appropriate zoning for the entire
criteria.note: Where zoning does not yet comply, the municipal office must verify at least a preliminary review. Absent a state or local code, the relevant International Code Council code applies.

criteria.heading: Infrastructure and utility availability
criteria.quote: Projects must install Broadband Infrastructure to all units and common area community rooms
criteria.note: Evidence that roads, utilities and capacity are in place or can be, typically a letter from the utility or municipal office, plus an architect's letter confirming broadband is in the plans.

criteria.heading: Development team
criteria.quote: Applicants new to LIHTCs must partner with a developer, sponsor, and/or consultant
criteria.note: The partner must have placed a LIHTC project in service within the prior five years. An applicant with an unfinished North Dakota project cannot apply again until it is at least under construction and on schedule. Convictions for dishonesty offences, and debarment from any state or federal program, make an applicant ineligible.

criteria.heading: Ownership
criteria.quote: The Applicant shall provide an Organizational Chart listing all proposed Developers, Guarantors
criteria.note: Chart must show ownership percentages, with an attestation about any intent to transfer.

criteria.heading: Financial projections
criteria.quote: Multifamily Application Exhibit A in Excel format
criteria.note: The Agency may decline an application whose hard debt service coverage ratio, or expense coverage ratio where no hard debt is proposed, falls below 1.10.

criteria.heading: Subsidies
criteria.note: Every anticipated federal, state or local subsidy must be listed in the application's SLR and HUD 2880 tab; where none are anticipated, a signed confirmation saying so is required.

criteria.heading: Public housing waiting list
criteria.note: To the public housing authority with jurisdiction, committing to work with it during lease-up and, where allowed, to give waitlisted households priority.

criteria.heading: Housing need
criteria.quote: Applicant shall provide a comprehensive market study of the housing needs of low-income
criteria.note: At the developer's expense, by a disinterested party, completed within six months of the close date, and meeting the NCHMA model content standards unless the Agency allows otherwise. It must show sustained demand and no adverse impact on existing affordable units.

criteria.heading: Capital needs assessment
criteria.quote: A Capital Needs Assessment (CNA) must be submitted with all application packages
criteria.note: Required for rehabilitation, adaptive reuse or acquisition where an existing building remains an asset. An exemption may be granted where other funding sources would make the timing costly, and an exempted requirement carries no scoring deduction, but the report is still due before carryover or equity closing.

criteria.heading: USDA financing
criteria.quote: An application proposing the inclusion of new or existing USDA debt must include written
criteria.note: Confirmation from the regional USDA officer on any transfer request and on any debt additional to existing USDA debt.

criteria.heading: Self-scoring
criteria.quote: The Applicant shall provide a self-scoring narrative indicating the number of points being sought
criteria.note: With the applicant's justification for each category claimed.
